title: To Do Checkbox Planner Stickers
author: Happy Printables Club
description:
These are Cute and Colorful To Do Checkbox Planner Stickers- Checklists Planner Stickers which will add a dynamic touch to your planner. 
These checklist stickers will be perfect for keeping a note of all your to do lists-shopping lists-grocery lists-household chores-study lists-reading book lists-tasks lists- and  much more.
 You can use these to add a colorful look to your planner/journal/notebooks. These will also serve as a great Reminder Stickers.
STICKER SIZE: 1.5 X 2 (FULL BOX)
SHEET SIZE- 8.5 X 11
WHAT YOU GET
You will get a ZIP file folder which includes:
1 JPEG 8.5 X 11
1 PNG 8.5 X 11
1 PDF 8.5 X 11
NO PHYSICAL PRODUCT WILL BE SHIPPED TO YOU- IT IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
PLEASE NOTE:
Depending on your computer monitor and resolution, colors may appear different from the actual download. Therefore there may be some variance between the way colors look on your screen compare to the actual print.
